name: How long does kitchen trim installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen trim installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen trim installation varies based on the kitchen's size, the complexity of the trim chosen, and whether it's part of a larger renovation. For a standard kitchen with basic trim, installation might take 1-2 days. More intricate designs, such as multiple layers of crown molding or custom profiles, can extend the timeline to 3-5 days. This estimate usually covers cutting, fitting, and initial fastening; painting or staining adds additional time. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen trim installation typically takes 1-2 days for standard kitchens, and 3-5 days for more complex designs. This timeline doesn't include finishing work.
